mentions.name: iceblox
mentions.description: A Linux runtime that runs Roblox on Linux, tuned to perform well even on old and low-end PCs. It exists because Roblox has no native Linux client and common workarounds assume modern hardware; it just reached 1.0 and adds Bazzite / Fedora Atomic support.
mentions.problem: Roblox has no native Linux client, and existing community workarounds quietly assume fairly modern machines — Sober recently dropped support for non-AVX CPUs, leaving users on older or low-end hardware out of luck.
mentions.audience: Roblox players on Linux, especially those on older or low-end PCs
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building iceblox, a linux runtime that runs Roblox extraordinarily well on Linux, and on the old and cheap PCs (blazing fast on new).
mentions.author: iceblox
